name: Shadowguard
summary: In the Undercity, Aelthalyste sends a Darkspear priest back to Orgrimmar. She sees that the young troll is ready for the tribe’s sacred rites, and Ur'kyo awaits in the Valley of Spirits.

sections.title: A Summons Across Continents
sections.body: Aelthalyste watches visiting troll priests in the Undercity. When an initiate has grown strong enough to face the tribe’s trials, she sends them across the Great Sea to learn from their own elders. She does not impose Forsaken teachings on them; their faith follows the traditions of their people.

sections.title: The Valley of Spirits
sections.body: In Orgrimmar’s Valley of Spirits, Ur'kyo tends to the Darkspear tribe’s spiritual needs and ancient rites. He welcomes the returning initiate and prepares them for a rite of passage. It joins the priest’s bond to the loa with spells that ward off harm.

faq.answer: Aelthalyste, a priest trainer in the Undercity’s War Quarter, starts the summons. She recognizes when a troll priest is ready for the tribe’s spiritual trials.

faq.q: Why does an Undercity trainer send me to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Forsaken priests have turned toward shadow, while Darkspear trolls draw spiritual power from the loa and tribal traditions. Aelthalyste respects this difference and sends developing troll priests home to learn their people’s arts from their own elder.
Ur'kyo is a Darkspear troll priest trainer in Orgrimmar’s Valley of Spirits. He teaches troll spiritual customs and rites of passage.

faq.q: What is the significance of the Shadowguard ability?
faq.answer: Shadowguard is a protective ward unique to troll priests. Shadowy spirits and loa blessings circle the caster, striking any enemy that attacks.

faq.q: Do other races receive this quest?
faq.answer: The summons is for Darkspear troll priests visiting the Undercity around their twentieth season of experience. Forsaken priests have separate rites and training there.

faq.q: Where in Orgrimmar is Ur'kyo located?
faq.answer: Ur'kyo is in the Valley of Spirits, Orgrimmar’s southern district set aside for the Darkspear trolls and their mystical practices.

angles.text: As a priest, you reach a milestone that joins the basics of holy and shadow magic with your people’s traditions.
As a Darkspear troll, your priestly training joins communion with the loa to the defense of your tribe. Ur'kyo preserves this inheritance in the Valley of Spirits.
As an undead, you may see Aelthalyste respect the distinct traditions of her living allies. Visiting trolls receive instruction from their own elders, rather than Forsaken doctrine.
